name: LILYGO T-Echo - LILYGO Wiki
snippet: T-Echo is a multi-functional LoRa communication device based on the nRF52840 chip, integrating an E-Paper screen, GPS positioning, NFC functionality, and multiple sensors.

name: LILYGO TTGO T-Echo NRF52840 LoRa Wireless Module User Manual
snippet: Comprehensive instruction manual for the LILYGO TTGO T-Echo NRF52840 LoRa SX1262 915MHz Wireless Module with L76K GPS and 1.54 E-Paper display. Includes setup, operation, maintenance, and specifications.

name: LILYGO T-Echo | Open Hardware Directory
snippet: The L76K GNSS module supports GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, and QZSS constellations. The T-Echo is the official reference hardware for Meshtastic LoRa mesh networking and also runs SoftRF aircraft tracking firmware. An optional BME280 variant adds barometric pressure, temperature, and humidity sensing.

name: LILYGO T-Echo : User's Guide - ManualShelf
snippet: Through a simple example, this document illustrates how to use Arduino, including the menu based configuration wizard, compiling the Arduino and firmware download to the NRF52840 module.

name: LILYGO® TTGO T-Echo devices - Meshtastic
snippet: The T-Echo by LILYGO® supports a low power consumption micro-controller and an e-ink display. Further information on the LILYGO® T-Echo devices can be found on LILYGO®'s GitHub page.

name: LILYGO T-Echo Meshtastic LoRa SX1262 Wireless Module  - Amazon
snippet: Compared with a single GPS system, the high-precision positioning multi-satellite system greatly increases the number of visible and usable satellites, improves positioning accuracy, and can achieve stable high-precision positioning even in complex urban environments.
